# Getting started

```{r}
#| label: stock-prices

microsoft_stock <- getSymbols("MSFT", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-03-01", to = "2026-11-01") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(MSFT), coredata(MSFT)) |>
  select(Date, MSFT.Close) |>
  rename(Close = MSFT.Close) |>
  mutate(COMP = "MSFT")

alphabet_stock <- getSymbols("GOOG", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-03-01", to = "2026-11-01") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(GOOG), coredata(GOOG)) |>
  select(Date, GOOG.Close) |>
  rename(Close = GOOG.Close) |>
  mutate(COMP = "GOOG")

meta_stock <- getSymbols("META", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-03-01", to = "2026-11-01") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(META), coredata(META)) |>
  select(Date, META.Close) |>
  rename(Close = META.Close) |>
  mutate(COMP = "META")

apple_stock <- getSymbols("AAPL", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-03-01", to = "2026-11-01") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(AAPL), coredata(AAPL)) |>
  select(Date, AAPL.Close) |>
  rename(Close = AAPL.Close) |>
  mutate(COMP = "AAPL")

nvidia_stock <- getSymbols("NVDA", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-03-01", to = "2026-11-01") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(NVDA), coredata(NVDA)) |>
  select(Date, NVDA.Close) |>
  rename(Close = NVDA.Close) |>
  mutate(COMP = "NVDA")

tesla_stock <- getSymbols("TSLA", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-03-01", to = "2026-11-01") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(TSLA), coredata(TSLA)) |>
  select(Date, TSLA.Close) |>   
  rename(Close = TSLA.Close) |>
  mutate(COMP = "TSLA")

stock_price_joined <- bind_rows(microsoft_stock, alphabet_stock, meta_stock, apple_stock, nvidia_stock, tesla_stock)

ten_qs <- read_csv("data/scraped-10qs.csv")

companies <- tibble(name1 = c("Apple", "Google", "Meta", "Microsoft", "Nvidia", "Tesla"),
                       name2 = c("AAPL", "GOOG", "META", "MSFT", "NVDA", "TSLA"))

ten_qs_updated <- ten_qs |> left_join(companies, by = c("COMP" = "name1"))

vertical_lines <- ten_qs_updated |>
  select(name2, "REP-D") |>
  rename(COMP = "name2", reported_date = "REP-D")

text_labels <- ten_qs_updated |>
  select(name2, "REP-D", RD) |>
  rename(COMP = "name2", reported_date = "REP-D") |>
  mutate(x_position = reported_date - days(5), 
         y_position = 1000,
         text_values = glue("Quarterly R&D Expense: {ten_qs_updated$RD} million"))
```

```{r}
#| label: time-series

# palletteer

# stock time series
ggplot(data=stock_price_joined, aes(x = Date, y = Close)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~COMP) +
  geom_vline(data=vertical_lines, aes(xintercept = reported_date)) +
  geom_text_repel(data=text_labels, aes(x = x_position, y = y_position, label = text_values), 
                  size = 3)

#annotate, geom_text, labels
```

```{r}
#| label: dot-plot

ggplot(data = ten_qs, aes(color = COMP, x = COMP, y = RD)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  labs(color = "Company")

# is this more helpful if date is somehow included? another visualization?
```

```{r}
#| label: text-analysis-scraping

ten_Qs_text <- readxl::read_xlsx("data/10q-links.xlsx")

# compartmentalize each variable
# Microsoft
microsoft <- ten_Qs_text |>
  filter(COMP == "Microsoft")

# Google
google <- ten_Qs_text |>
  filter(COMP == "Google")

# Meta
meta <- ten_Qs_text |>
  filter(COMP == "Meta")

# Apple
apple <- ten_Qs_text |>
  filter(COMP == "Apple")

# Nvidia
nvidia <- ten_Qs_text |>
  filter(COMP == "Nvidia")

# Tesla
tesla <- ten_Qs_text |>
  filter(COMP == "Tesla")

# create sec session
my_ua <- "AmherstCollege yjang27@amherst.edu"
sec_session <- session("https://www.sec.gov", user_agent(my_ua))

# add empty column to store values
ten_Qs_text_scraped <- ten_Qs_text |>
  mutate(text = NA)

# -------------------------------Scraping---------------------------------------
# Microsoft
for (i in 1:4) {
  all_text_microsoft <- session_jump_to(sec_session, microsoft$HTML[i]) |>
    read_html() |>
    html_elements("span") |>
    html_text2()
  
  detect_1 <- which(str_detect(all_text_microsoft, "ITEM 2. MANAGEMENT’S"))
  
  detect_2 <- which(str_detect(all_text_microsoft, "ITEM 3. QUANTITATIVE"))
  
  ten_Qs_text_scraped$text[i] <- all_text_microsoft[detect_1:detect_2]
}

# Google
for (i in 1:4) {
  all_text_google <- session_jump_to(sec_session, google$HTML[i]) |>
    read_html() |>
    html_elements("span") |>
    html_text2()
  
  detect_1 <- which(str_detect(all_text_google, "MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS"))
  
  detect_2 <- which(str_detect(all_text_google, "QUANTITATIVE AND QUALITATIVE DISCLOSURES ABOUT MARKET RISK"))
  
  ten_Qs_text_scraped$text[i+4] <- all_text_google[detect_1:detect_2]
}

# Meta
for (i in 1:4) {
  all_text_meta <- session_jump_to(sec_session, meta$HTML[i]) |>
    read_html() |>
    html_elements("span") |>
    html_text2()
  
  detect_1 <- which(str_detect(all_text_meta, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations"))
  
  detect_2 <- which(str_detect(all_text_meta, "Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk"))
  
  ten_Qs_text_scraped$text[i+8] <- all_text_meta[detect_1:detect_2]
}

# Apple
for (i in 1:4) {
  all_text_apple <- session_jump_to(sec_session, apple$HTML[i]) |>
    read_html() |>
    html_elements("span") |>
    html_text2()
  
  detect_1 <- which(str_detect(all_text_apple, "Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations"))[2]
  
  detect_2 <- which(str_detect(all_text_apple, "Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk"))[2]
  
  ten_Qs_text_scraped$text[i+12] <- all_text_apple[detect_1:detect_2]
}

# Nvidia
for (i in 1:4) {
  all_text_nvidia <- session_jump_to(sec_session, nvidia$HTML[i]) |>
    read_html() |>
    html_elements("span") |>
    html_text2()
  
  detect_1 <- which(str_detect(all_text_nvidia, "Item 2."))[3]
  
  detect_2 <- which(str_detect(all_text_nvidia, "Item 3\\."))[2]
  
  ten_Qs_text_scraped$text[i+16] <- all_text_nvidia[detect_1:detect_2]
}

# Tesla
for (i in 1:4) {
  all_text_tesla <- session_jump_to(sec_session, tesla$HTML[i]) |>
    read_html() |>
    html_elements("span") |>
    html_text2()
  
  detect_1 <- which(str_detect(all_text_tesla, "ITEM 2. MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS"))
  
  detect_2 <- which(str_detect(all_text_tesla, "ITEM 3. QUANTITATIVE AND QUALITATIVE DISCLOSURES ABOUT MARKET RISK"))
  
  ten_Qs_text_scraped$text[i+20] <- all_text_tesla[detect_1:detect_2]
}

```
